svg.text: Every effect is one function: (input image, params, aux) → output image. Order = position in the FX stack.
The same texture flows through; each stage owns one transform.
Reorder the stack → reorder the functions. No hidden state between FX.
2 · The full pipeline — every effect as an input → output node
Default order shown. Each node names the image it consumes (IN) and the image it produces (OUT); the renderer decides which nodes share a GPU pass.
runs last — the boundary is fixed
3 · How the renderer realizes the chain
Adjacent transforms share a pass (fusion). Every other category owns a real pass. Textures ping-pong so a pass never reads what it writes.
categories that need their own pass
Cost rule: bandwidth = passes × resolution. Fusion is not an optimisation bolted on — it is how the model stays affordable.
5 · Ordering — today vs the explicit model
Shaders compare these integers per pixel to decide
who has already run. Ordering lives inside kernels.
Scheduler fuses adjacent transforms, then walks
the list. Order is the array; no per-pixel integers.
